intent: Mobile feedback round fixes: tab dropdown double-tap race, focus ring suppression with !important, mobile collage staggered fade, newsletter field stagger inside a faded column, hero zoom CSS fail-safe, George Marston tilt phones-only; plus Playwright fixtures for M6, M21/M22, M23, M4/M16/M30/M39, M11a/M26/M31b.

findings.title: Hero zoom fail-safe can cause the very jump M23 forbids when the bundle arrives after 3s
findings.suggested_fix: In heroImageScale.ts, skip the zoom (or start from the current computed scale) when the fail-safe has already fired, e.g. if performance.now() > 3000 leave the photo at scale 1.
findings.why_it_matters: On a slow phone connection the photo shows at normal size after 3s, then heroImageScale.fromTo resets it to 1.12 and shrinks it again: a visible pop.
evidence: src/utils/heroImageScale.ts:35 gsap.fromTo(image, { scale: HERO_IMAGE_START_SCALE } ...) runs unconditionally

findings.title: Collage stagger counter is page-wide, so every tile after the third waits 0.5s after its own trigger
findings.suggested_fix: Use ScrollTrigger.batch (or stagger only tiles that trigger together) so a lone tile scrolled into view later is not delayed.
findings.why_it_matters: Minor lag on lower collage tiles; one-by-one still holds because each tile has its own trigger.

findings.title: Comment misstates GSAP: kill() does not fire onComplete; the real hazard is killTweensOf emptying the old timeline
findings.suggested_fix: Reword the comment: emptying the previous timeline via killTweensOf let it complete and run its onComplete, so the previous timeline is killed outright.
findings.first_evidence: // Only the latest open or close may finish: a killed timeline still fires
findings.why_it_matters: Maintainability only; code behaviour is correct.

actionable_findings.title: Hero zoom fail-safe can cause the very jump M23 forbids when the bundle arrives after 3s
actionable_findings.suggested_fix: In heroImageScale.ts, skip the zoom when the fail-safe has already fired (performance.now() > 3000).

Reduced motion: the pre-bundle CSS still zooms the hero to 1.12 and heroImageScale returns early, so the photo snaps to 1 when reveal-ready lands (pre-existing).
